title: heliotropium zeylanicum var. subulatum
intro: Heliotropium zeylanicum var. subulatum, commonly known as Zeylanium, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in treating various ailments like fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Zeylanium include its expectorant, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which aid in relieving symptoms of bronchitis, asthma, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Zeylanium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
